body.title: Define sc2 ledger contracts and immutable basis
body.summary: Add exact sc2 EvidenceV1/CoverageV1/ReviewLedgerV1 types and typed catalog, trusted-receipt, attempt and delta inputs in ledger-types.ts. Reuse s1 canonical snapshot/hash/freeze helpers and explicit metadata/count limits.
acceptanceChecks: Exact HLD sc2 fields retained; sc1/sc6 imported, never duplicated or redesigned.
Trusted adapter outputs remain separate from reviewer proposals; named ReviewLedgerError causes and typed limits explicit.
Canonical IDs bind subject, requirement namespace and provenance; defensive copies/frozen outputs reject invalid or oversized metadata.
Focused contract/identity tests pass; no store, model, MCP or verdict implementation.

tests.name: sc2 contracts, canonical identities and bounded immutable values
